# Treemap classifies nodes by categorical facet; git provenance hides generated by default via a lens

Status: accepted (vrs-interview + published design proposal + kit-source evidence)

## Context

A code-change treemap (`fromGitDiff`) is dominated on first paint by whatever
churned most — and for our repos that is frequently **generated** output
(regenerated CI YAML, `*.generated.ts`, genie-composed `package.json` /
`pnpm-workspace.yaml`), which is noise for a reviewer. The only pre-existing way
to drop it was to hand-enumerate leaf ids through `defaultExcludedIds`, a
story-only React prop that is neither part of the authored block contract nor
reusable: every author re-derives an opaque id list.

"Generated" is not a treemap concern to be hand-listed. It is a machine-readable
property git already resolves per path: the repo's root `.gitattributes` marks it
`linguist-generated=true` (and `linguist-vendored=true`), which already drives
GitHub's own PR-diff collapsing. The source of truth exists; nothing new needs to
be invented, only read.

Three forks were resolved with the operator (see the published proposal at
`/r/treemap-generated-provenance/latest` and
[.experiments/facet-r61-and-gitattributes-evidence.md](../02-medium/05-blocks/04-treemap/.experiments/facet-r61-and-gitattributes-evidence.md)):

1. **How default-hiding relates to the completeness charter (MED.BLK.TREE-R61).**
   R61 requires that the zero-interaction default never misrepresent the tree as
   complete; every node stays countable and reachable by drill/search.
2. **Where the "generated-ness" intent lives**, given the treemap is a *generic*
   value-hierarchy component that also renders disk and bundle models.
3. **Where the impure `git check-attr` enrichment lives.**

## Decision

- **Nodes carry a generic categorical `facets` map — the categorical twin of the
  existing numeric `metrics`.** `TreemapNode` gains `facets?: Record<string,
  string>`. `metrics` (numeric) already drives value-colour; `facets` (categorical)
  drives group-colour *and* filtering. The generic model never interprets facet
  values — it stays domain-agnostic, so the same mechanism serves disk/bundle
  models and future classes (test, lockfile) with no change. The block's effect
  `Schema` decoder (the `Schema.suspend` `TreemapNode`) is extended alongside the
  TS type; the field is optional and additive (published kit, live consumers).

- **Default-hide is a lens projection governed by R61, not a new honesty rule
  (fork 1 → "lens projection under R61").** `TreemapLens` gains `hiddenFacets?:
  Record<string, readonly string[]>` (e.g. `{ provenance: ['generated'] }`). At
  projection time a facet match resolves to a **leaf-id Set that seeds the existing
  `excludedIds` filter** — inheriting REMOVE+RE-SUM, drill-persistence, reveal, and
  the resting `"N hidden"` badge (`FilterPanel` already renders it when the set is
  non-empty). So the zero-interaction default surfaces its own incompleteness at
  rest and every hidden leaf stays counted, drillable, and searchable: R61 already
  governs it, with no new requirement and no new UI. Container-emptying (an
  all-generated `.github/workflows/`) falls out of re-sum for free — no
  container-level facet. A "raw" lens omits `hiddenFacets` and hides nothing;
  default visibility is thus a switchable, reviewable *lens policy*, never a
  hardcode or a silent prune.

- **The treemap stays git-blind; the git→provenance binding is a separate
  authoring concern (fork 2 → "agnostic facet + separate git binding").** The
  treemap component knows only abstract facets. The mapping
  `linguist-generated → provenance:'generated'` (and `linguist-vendored →
  'vendored'`) lives in the `fromGitDiff` adapter; a typed closed enum `Provenance
  = 'authored' | 'generated' | 'vendored'` exists only at the adapter output
  boundary and maps into the generic string facet. The component never touches git.

- **The impure enrichment is a thin Vista-local author-time shell over a shared
  `FileChange` contract (fork 3 → "thin shell + shared contract").** Classification
  is computed once at author time — the same place we already run `git diff
  --numstat` and freeze into `diff-data.ts` — by one batched `git check-attr
  linguist-generated -- <paths>` (or `--stdin`), and frozen into the review; the
  pure layers below never call git. The reusable unit is the `FileChange`
  contract `{ path, insertions, deletions, provenance }`, which `fromGitDiff`
  consumes. `unspecified` → `authored`; degrade to all-`authored` outside a git
  repo. A first-class `git changes --json` porcelain is deferred (YAGNI with one
  consumer); the `FileChange` contract is the promotion seam once janitor/CI become
  a second consumer.

### Rejected / deferred

- **Precompute excluded ids at author time (fork 1/2 alternative).** Rejected:
  zero contract change, but bakes an opaque id list into every review — not
  reusable, no reveal-with-reason, and it dead-ends (no path to vendored/test or
  facet-colour).
- **Name "generated" in the treemap requirement / a `hideGenerated` block flag.**
  Rejected on the domain-agnosticism driver: it couples a generic value-hierarchy
  component to git semantics and breaks its reuse for disk/bundle models — the very
  property that makes facet-on-model correct.
- **`git changes --json` porcelain now, or an effect-utils `GitChanges` service.**
  Deferred: right eventual home for the impure enrichment, but overreach with a
  single consumer; author-time is a shell/freeze step, not an Effect runtime.

## Consequences

- New capability requirement **MED.BLK.TREE-R73** (facet-scoped projection: hide /
  reveal by categorical facet, under R61) and a new authoring requirement
  **MED.AUTH-R74** (model builders derive classification from a machine-readable
  source; git provenance via `.gitattributes`, frozen at author time). Both refine
  existing parents; R61 is unchanged (it already governs the honesty invariant).
  Requirement numbers are globally unique across the Vista VRS (restructure 0067),
  so these take the next free numbers R73/R74, not per-node successors.
- Additive kit contract: `TreemapNode.facets?`, `TreemapLens.hiddenFacets?`, the
  extended `Schema.suspend` decoder, and `fromGitDiff` accepting `FileChange[]`
  (the numstat-string overload stays for the no-attributes case). `defaultExcludedIds`
  is untouched; facet-hiding is a higher-level seed of the same filter store.
- The same facet dimension later powers `colorBy: 'facet'` and vendored/test
  filters with no further model change.
- The PR #1255 recap can be re-cut with generated hidden-by-default (revealable):
  authored churn leads; the `"N hidden"` badge keeps it honest.
